angle: Job postings as the finder: welder/fitter/fabricator/robotic-welding postings whose text names trailers, lowboys, flatbeds, dump trailers, chassis, frames, suspensions, axles, hitches, light towers, generators or compressors; employer and site resolved from the posting, then checked on employer or job-board pages with tools/fetch_page.py
searches_until_dry: not reached: search 30 (VA/FL/NY/CO) still produced new plants (Interstate Glen Lyn VA, Carry-On Montross VA, Utility Atkins VA); stopped at the ~30-search cap
notes: Searches 27-28 named companies (Hendrickson, SAF-Holland, Ridewell, Reyco, Link; Generac Mobile, Allmand, Doosan); Allmand is marked name-seeded.

Aggregator postings (hirebase, career.com, careerbuilder, factoryfix, qureos) mostly returned 403/404/410; most leads could not be confirmed on a fetched page in the time available and are listed with plant_confirmed=false and no quote.

Anonymous staffing postings not listed as plants: Randstad Thomasville (flatbed trailer welding, state unknown), Aerotek Haleyville AL (trailer beams), Aerotek Gatesville TX (heavy-haul, likely Kalyn Siebert), Aerotek Evansville WI (trailer frames), ExpressPros Chilton WI (trailer frames/ramps), Express Mount Pleasant TX, Lavoro USA NE Iowa heavy-haul open-deck maker, StaffBuildersHR Plant City FL (transfer/dump trailers), Fitzgerald GA trailer parts shop, Aerotek Haleyville/Waco, Nampa ID robot operator (trailer components).
Great Dane Danville PA appeared on the live listing where the search snippet said Elysburg PA; treated as one site at Danville.
No intermodal container chassis or mobile-power (towable generator/light tower/compressor) plant was confirmed from postings; Allmand Holdrege NE is a name-seeded lead only.

plant_confirmed rule: true only when a fetched page places welding/welder hiring at that specific site (site posting or site-specific statement); a city plus a company manufacturing statement is company-level only (false).
Today 2026-11-20; quotes checked with fetch_page.py --check; archive_url not attempted.
